# Baagul LLP · Digital Marketing & Web Engineering Studio

> High-performance digital marketing, full-funnel search engine optimization, modern Next.js web development, and digital growth systems engineered in Bengaluru, India.

## Main Sections

- [Homepage](https://baagul.in/): Overview of services, portfolio case studies, technical engineering stack, and studio capabilities.
- [Services Hub](https://baagul.in/services): Directory of all 10 core agency services, technical deliverables, and engagement workflows.
- [Team & About](https://baagul.in/team): Company philosophy, founding leadership, design systems, and engineering ethos.
- [Case Studies](https://baagul.in/services/seo-optimizations/client-success-stories): Documented performance results, organic traffic metrics, and client implementations.

## Core Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://baagul.in/services/web-design): High-speed Next.js, React, and TypeScript web applications with sub-second page loads and accessible semantic UI.
- [SEO Optimization](https://baagul.in/services/seo-optimizations): Technical site health, semantic indexing, Core Web Vitals optimization, and organic search ranking authority.
- [Logo Design & Visual Identity](https://baagul.in/services/logo-design): Comprehensive branding, typographic hierarchies, color geometry, and vector asset guidelines.
- [Guest Posts & PR](https://baagul.in/services/guest-post): High-authority editorial placements, brand PR features, and contextual link profile architecture.
- [Graphic Designing](https://baagul.in/services/graphics-design): Conversion-optimized creative assets, digital campaign collateral, and print marketing systems.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://baagul.in/services/e-commerce-solutions): Headless commerce architectures, frictionless checkout flows, and catalog conversion optimization.
- [WordPress & CMS Development](https://baagul.in/services/wordpress-development): Enterprise WordPress engineering, custom Gutenberg blocks, and secure headless CMS solutions.
- [Paid Promotions & Media Buying](https://baagul.in/services/paid-promotions): High-ROAS Google Ads, Meta Ads, and programmatic acquisition campaigns driven by real-time analytics.
- [Video Editing & Motion Graphics](https://baagul.in/services/video-editing): Dynamic promotional edits, social media video reels, and cinematic brand storytelling.
- [App Development](https://baagul.in/services/app-development): Scalable cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built with React Native and modern APIs.
